_doc: Ground truth for grading. STRUCTURAL SWOT-critical fields (name/category/offerings/languages/...) grade from benchmark/urls.json metadata and need nothing here. Per-URL entries below hold labels the OWNER fills: `expected_objective` (a MetaObjective — 'Sales'/'OUTCOME_SALES'/'SALES') + `expected_destination` (a Destination value — 'online_store','whatsapp',...) drive the U1 gate via `python -m benchmark.grade_u1`. Leave null = unlabelled (skipped, never fabricated). Fuzzy fields (audience/value_propositions/tone_of_voice) are a separate labelling pass (T-2 W4).
